bug_fixed.root_cause: FastAPI route ordering issue - /impersonate/{tenant_id} was defined BEFORE /impersonate/end, causing 'end' to be matched as a tenant_id path parameter
bug_fixed.fix: Moved /impersonate/end route definition BEFORE /impersonate/{tenant_id} in super_admin.py
